title: npc player
description: This project adds player-like mannique by data pack, defining some simple action simulating player
body:
###  Project Description

**NPC Player**

Bring your Minecraft worlds to life with this lightweight, vanilla-friendly data pack! Inspired by the classic Mannequin model, this pack allows you to encounter NPC players using only standard data pack mechanics. Perfect for adventure maps, server lobbies, roleplay servers, or decorative builds, it provides a seamless way to simulate player entities without requiring any client-side mods.

###  Key Features

- **True Vanilla Compatibility**: Works entirely as a data pack. No Forge, Fabric, or client-side mods are required!
- **Custom Player NPCs**: Spawn, customize, and manage mannequin-style player entities with custom skins, names, and poses.
- **Lightweight & Performant**: Built using efficient functions to ensure smooth gameplay and minimal server lag.
- **Easy to Use**: Simple setup with intuitive commands and a clear in-game guide.
- **Highly Customizable**: Easily tweak NPC behaviors, interactions, and appearances to fit your specific world or server needs.

### ️ Installation & Usage

1. Download the latest `.zip` file from the **Files** tab.
2. Place the data pack into your world's `datapacks` folder (`saves/[Your World]/datapacks/`) or your server's `world/datapacks/` directory.
3. In-game, run `/reload` to load the pack.
4. Use the provided setup commands (check the in-game wiki or documentation) to spawn and configure your first Mannequin NPC!

### ️ Compatibility & Requirements

- **Minecraft Version**: Compatible with Minecraft [Insert Supported Version, e.g., 1.21.11 - 26.1.2]
- **Requirements**: Vanilla Minecraft (Java Edition). No external mods or plugins needed.
- **Multiplayer**: Fully supported on multiplayer servers.

###  Support & Feedback

Your feedback helps improve this project! If you encounter any bugs, have feature suggestions, or need help with setup, please open an issue on the [...].

> **Note**: This project is an original creation inspired by the Mannequin concept. It does not contain any assets or code from existing mods and is fully compliant with Mojang's EULA and Modrinth's content guidelines.
